**sdd/issue-144-governance-v3/apply-progress**

**What**: Slice PR1 of issue-144-governance-v3 complete, including a fresh-review fix-first round (1 MEDIUM + 1 LOW + 1 NIT). PR1 code/tests/docs are done on branch `feat/issue-144-s1-l1-registry` (4 commits), not pushed, no PR opened yet.

**Why**: PR1 = L1 CI job (local-checks) + REQUIRED_JOBS/DETECTION_JOBS registry refactor (design §7, REQ-L1-1, REQ-L3-3). A fresh review found the registry split had invalidated claims in the LIVE doc `brain/core/methodology/workflow-governance.md`, which agents cannot edit directly (Tier 2).

**Where**:
- `brain/scripts/vcs/governance-checks.mjs` — REQUIRED_JOBS=['issue-link','diff-size','local-checks'], DETECTION_JOBS=[], GOVERNANCE_JOBS=union, checkContexts() reads REQUIRED_JOBS only.
- `brain/scripts/vcs/governance-checks.test.mjs` — two-tier registry tests, local-checks presence tests; drift-guard regression test rewritten to be order-sensitive (`assert.deepEqual(yamlJobNames, GOVERNANCE_JOBS)` — exact order, not sorted-set) instead of duplicating the original sorted-set drift-guard; added a `// PR2a:` comment flagging the checkContexts() DETECTION_JOBS-exclusion loop as currently vacuous (DETECTION_JOBS=[]) until PR2a wires a real detection job.
- `.github/workflows/governance.yml` — new `local-checks` job (checkout + repo:check + brain:nav + npm test).
- `openspec/changes/issue-144-governance-v3/brain-drafts/workflow-governance.md` — NEW Tier-2 draft: full corrected copy of the live doc with (a) "single source of truth" language fixed to describe checkContexts()->REQUIRED_JOBS vs GOVERNANCE_JOBS-as-full-union, (b) new `local-checks` row + `### Invariant 5` section added, (c) header note marking it a draft for human review/move. `brain/core/**` itself was never touched (verified via `git diff d290325..HEAD --stat -- brain/core/` = empty).
- `openspec/changes/issue-144-governance-v3/tasks.md` — PR1 checkboxes all `[x]` except the final `[Manual]` CI-behavior acceptance item (deferred to actual PR open/observe).

**Commits on `feat/issue-144-s1-l1-registry`** (tracker `feature/issue-144-governance-v3` reset to pre-work `d290325`, not pushed):
1. `6bea209` refactor(governance): split GOVERNANCE_JOBS into REQUIRED_JOBS/DETECTION_JOBS
2. `86ef83d` ci(governance): add local-checks job for repo:check, brain:nav, npm test
3. `5c363df` docs(governance): draft workflow-governance.md update for registry split (#144)
4. `ad0c351` test(governance): make drift-guard regression order-sensitive, not duplicate

**Test evidence**: 616 baseline -> 622 after PR1 (steady through all 4 commits; the review-round commits changed test bodies, not counts). `npm run repo:check` and `npm run brain:nav` clean at every commit. Strict TDD RED->GREEN followed for all original PR1 tasks (see prior progress note, id search same topic_key).

**Learned**:
- Job name `local-checks` (per tasks.md Micro-decisions) not `ci-checks` (an earlier apply-launch prompt said ci-checks) — tasks.md is authoritative, followed it, flagged as prompt/artifact mismatch not an SDD deviation.
- Tier-2 "no agent writes to brain/core or brain/project" is enforced procedurally here by drafting under `openspec/changes/<change>/brain-drafts/` rather than editing the live doc — this is the pattern PR6b/PR8 in this same change also use for CODEOWNERS and the ADR draft.
- When a fresh review asks for an "order-sensitive" test to replace a duplicate, `assert.deepEqual(array, array)` (unsorted) vs the original's `assert.deepEqual(sorted, sorted)` is a genuinely stronger, non-duplicate assertion — cheap way to satisfy "collapse or make genuinely different" review feedback without losing coverage.

**Remaining**: same as before — PR2a through PR8 slices untouched. PR1 itself still needs: fresh fresh-review sign-off, push, PR open, and the one deferred [Manual] acceptance task (observe local-checks trip/clear on this very PR in live CI).
